   Cases for  gomd -r  and the TUI

  Prose mentions x before the span  x , and the word code before  code .

  A long paragraph that keeps going so that the inline span lands near the
  wrap point  wrapped span here  and continues after it with more words.

  A link whose text wraps across the edge of the pane this link text is long
  enough to wrap 🔗 https://example.com/wrap at narrow widths.

  ## Wrapped code

    short line
    a very long line in a code block that is much wider than the content pane
  so glamour has to wrap it onto more lines
    end

    the block after the wrapped one

  ## Blank lines and empty blocks

    func a() {

        return
    }


  After the empty block.

  ## Nested blocks

  • A list item with code:
    echo in-list

  • Second item with  inline  code.

  │ A quote with code:
  │
  │   echo in-quote

  ## Table spans

   Key                                  │ Action
  ──────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────
    j                                   │ down  1
    k                                   │ up  1

  ## Indented code

    indented line one
    indented line two

  The end.
